reason: GT 1.21 replaces GTRecipeLookup with RecipeDB and its public nested RecipeIterator. Core input grouping must preserve independent ME slots, physical buses, shared fluids and ghost circuits.

component_fluid_index.registration: NativeRecipeSearchIndex.register(IEventBus) during common setup, after GT native ingredient registration
component_fluid_index.implementation: Public MapIngredientTypeManager registrations; quantities are unwrapped, each matching component predicate gets its own lookup key, weak predicate references allow obsolete databases to be collected.
component_fluid_index.reason: Equivalent fluid identities use different direct/tag HolderSets, and partial component predicates may match keys with additional components; the native hash/index cannot discover all overlapping predicates.

validation_scope: Selected real production search classes and both composed Core/Additions Mixins are loaded with native GT and NeoForge. Mutable multiple-mode behavior is checked using a native RecipeLogic fixture implementing IMultipleRecipeSearch; the complete Additions MutableRecipesLogic and its callers are not yet compiled or run. Full production component-index performance has not been profiled.
preserved_behavior: Native ordinary-machine and colored input routing
Independent Core item bus and ME slot groups with shared fluids/catalysts/circuit inputs
One candidate per group or multiple candidates according to recipe logic mode
Stable recipe-ID deduplication, reset, repeated hasNext and isolated concurrent holders
Custom recipe runners only when no accepted indexed or cached candidate exists
